job.job_description:
Position: Gen AI Engineer / Senior Gen AI Engineer / Lead Gen AI Engineer

We are hiring experienced Generative AI Engineers to design and develop enterprise AI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, and Python. The role involves building intelligent applications, integrating enterprise data, developing scalable APIs, and deploying production-ready AI solutions.

Key Responsibilities
Develop enterprise GenAI applications using LLMs.
Build RAG-based solutions with Vector Databases.
Develop AI Agents and Agentic workflows.
Integrate AI solutions with enterprise systems using APIs.
Design and optimize prompts for business use cases.
Improve AI response accuracy, performance, and scalability.
Required Skills
Python (FastAPI/Flask)
LLMs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Gemini)
RAG, Embeddings, Chunking
LangChain / LangGraph / LlamaIndex
AI Agents / MCP (Model Context Protocol)
Vector Databases (Pinecone, ChromaDB, Weaviate, FAISS)
REST APIs
Cloud Platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
Experience Levels
Gen AI Engineer: 2–5 years of relevant GenAI experience
Senior Gen AI Engineer: 5–8 years of relevant GenAI experience
Lead Gen AI Engineer: 10–15 years of relevant GenAI experience
